mentions.name: Interactive code explainer
mentions.description: An interactive explainer for code that helps developers rebuild and maintain their working theory of a codebase and its architecture when agents write most of the code, letting them learn the architecture before or while designing the next feature rather than after.
mentions.problem: When agents write most of the code, developers lose their working theory of the code and architecture; adversarial agent reviews catch errors but do not disseminate codebase knowledge.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an interactive explainer for code. When agents write most of the code, I find I'm losing the working theory of the code/architecture.
